observations: A dark, rounded head-like form sits against a flat lavender field; two large hands grip the top edge, fingers splayed, framing the upper mass.
The left eye socket holds a gold oval with a vertical drip line; the right socket contains a tight yellow spiral ringed by dark coiling lines, creating two visually distinct focal points.
Dense multicolored scribble lines—teal, pink, yellow, black—layer over dark brown-black volumes, with white highlight spots on the lower teeth and a wide open mouth below center.
reading: Two mismatched eyes anchor a face that reads as both mask and object: one a flat gold shape with a dripping line, the other a wound-tight spiral. Hands gripping the skull from above add a sense of something held or displayed rather than simply present. The lavender ground keeps the dark form cool and slightly suspended, while the scribble lines give the surface a restless quality beneath the solid volumes.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nifty faces #124 and nnxyz nifty faces #126. The collector connects nnxyz to scrimshaw through surface line-work over dark volumes—a quality visible across the inspected neighbors.

connections.reason: nnxyz nifty faces #126 shares the spiral-eye motif and dark-volume-plus-scribble surface, but replaces the flat lavender ground with a warm striped field, sharpening the contrast between the two works.
nnxyz rawblocks #32 layers dense colored scribble lines over a dark rounded form against a flat ground, but the face fills the frame frontally with no hands and a blue rather than lavender field.

lookingQuestion: What does the difference between the two eye forms—one a flat gold oval with a drip line, the other a tight coiled spiral—do to how you move across the face?
ambiguities: The hands gripping the top could belong to the figure itself or suggest an external holder; the image does not resolve this.
nnxyz nifty faces #124 shares dark volumes and scribble lines but its warm orange ground and different eye treatment made it a weaker formal match than the two selected connections.
